purpose: Daily discovery queue for publicly verifiable BANHALMI trust and authority signals. This is an intake registry, not a claim registry.

searchPlan.recency: prioritize last 30 days, then unresolved historical authority evidence

qualityRules: Prefer first-party institutional or reputable independent sources over scraped aggregators.
Public social content is evidence only when the post and account can be independently resolved and the relationship is explicit.
A mention, tag or repost is not a client, commission, partnership or endorsement by default.
Do not use follower counts, likes or engagement as authority evidence without a separate reason.
Deduplicate syndicated, mirrored, archived and reposted copies before counting.
Do not publish candidate records into machine authority layers until verification is high confidence.

promotionPolicy.verified: source resolved, relationship classified, deduplicated and provenance preserved
promotionPolicy.promotable: verified and useful to an existing evidence layer or a justified authority asset
promotionPolicy.rejected: unverifiable, duplicate, misleading, relationship-inflating or low-quality
